items.title: Adobe's Options Price A Year That Runs Past Its Own Range

items.title: Autodesk (ADSK) Q2 Beat Meets Softer Q3 Profit Outlook
items.summary: Autodesk (NasdaqGS:ADSK) reported Q2 earnings that came in above market expectations, with revenue also ahead of forecasts. The company issued a weaker profit outlook for Q3 than analysts had anticipated, which raised investor concerns about near term earnings momentum. This mix of stronger than expected recent results and softer guidance has affected sentiment toward the stock in recent trading. items.title: Autodesk (ADSK) Grew Revenue 16% but Remaining Performance Obligations Rose Only 2%
items.summary: Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADSK) reported fiscal 2027 second-quarter revenue of $2.046 billion, up 16% year over year, while billings increased 10% to $1.854 billion. The obligations data presented a more complicated picture. Total remaining performance obligations, or RPO, rose only 2% to $7.433 billion. items.title: Why Autodesk (ADSK) Shares Are Sliding Today
items.summary: Shares of 3D design software company Autodesk (NASDAQ:ADSK) fell 3.9% in the afternoon session after the company issued full-year adjusted earnings guidance whose midpoint trailed analyst forecasts despite reporting second-quarter results that topped estimates.

items.title: ADSK Q2 Deep Dive: AI Strategy, Operations Expansion, and Evolving Business Model
items.summary: 3D design software company Autodesk (NASDAQ:ADSK) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 16.1% year on year to $2.05 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $2.13 billion at the midpoint, 2.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.30 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
